nome_articolo: Goodsmile Company T Shin Getter Robot Armageddon Moderoid Getter 1 OVA Ver (Model Kit)
descrizione:
From "Shin Getter Robot Armageddon" comes a MODEROID plastic model of Getter 1 (OVA Ver.)!

- The plastic model is based on T·O·P! Fuchi's garage kit statue design!
- The model stands at approximately 150mm in height and its joints are articulated for easy posing. Interchangeable hand parts are included.
- Two Getter Tomahawks and two Getter Machine Guns are included.
- Getter Wings are included in both plastic and cloth forms.
- The cloth version of the Getter Wings include a wire that makes dynamic posing possible.
- The torso Getter Beam has a firing opening that extends out of the abdomen.
- The various parts of the mecha have been separated into various colored and clear runners, and some parts of the model are pre-painted, making it easy to recreate the mecha from the series with a simple assembly.

nome_articolo: Goodsmile Company Mazinger Z Brickroid (Action Figure)
descrizione:
BRICKROID is a series of collectible robots. Standing at around 5cm tall, these robot toys are made with the concept of "cool and fun"! The series uses a uniform design format to bring together robots from a plethora of media. The small bodies are loaded with all the fun of posing and displaying them.

- The toy stands at approximately 5cm tall and is made with ABS.
- Featuring articulated heads, arms, and legs.
- Two types of hand parts are included: fist parts and hand parts with a 3mm diameter hole.
- A convex block base is included. The holes on the bottoms of their feet can be attached to 5mm diameter studs, allowing them to be displayed on dedicated stands. They can also be attached to generic brick toys with the same measurements.

nome_articolo: Hot Toys Prey 1/6 Feral Predator Battle Damaged Version (Action Figure)
descrizione:
This is as far as you go. No more. This is it." - Naru

As the showdown unfolds in Prey, the Feral Predator finds itself heavily wounded after a deadly chase through the swamp and forest. The courageous Comanche warrior Naru turns the Predator's own technology against it, taking its mask and using its targeting laser to redirect a fatal shot back at the creature's head. With body scarred and limbs severed, this battle-damaged state captures the brutal, raw conclusion of the hunt.

Sideshow and Hot Toys proudly presents the Feral Predator (Battle Damaged Version) Sixth Scale Figure. The head sculpt features new paint applications and a highly detailed skin texture that accurately reflects his appearance in the final battle, along with finely crafted, enhanced thin rubber hair that evokes the wild look from the film. Two sets of interchangeable mandibles are included, one opened and one with a broken tusk to reflect the Predator's wounded state. The Predator collectible also includes six pieces of interchangeable hands and an interchangeable severed right arm, which the lower arm part can be attached to the tree trunk diorama piece for dramatic display.

Standing approximately 37 cm tall, the Predator's body is rendered in battle-damaged paintwork, replicating its green blood and scars from the clashes. His costume includes a utility belt with a lamellar skirt and a pair of sculpted ankle wraps. His arsenal of weapons includes a wrist shield, a magnetically attachable bolt gun, a combistick that can be separated, a magnetically attachable combistick in retracted state, a whip, and a pair of wristblades - capturing the mix of primitive and alien weaponry that defines the Prey Predator. To heighten the display, the set includes a bone mask with red LED light-up function, a backpack, two bones that hang from the belt, a forest-themed diorama figure base recreating the dense woods where the showdown took place, and an axe and two arrows that can be attached to the diorama base for added realism.

This battle-damaged action figure of Feral Predator is a must-have for fans of Prey and collectors who appreciate the savage beauty of the hunt.
